propositions: The eval/calibration surface rejects activated project code-review criteria because _code_review_prompt_id and calibrate_criterion lack repository context and code-review membership branches.
When repo_root is provided, _code_review_prompt_id must admit logical ids returned by code_review.registry.effective_criteria mapped through criterion_prompt_id with gate_key=code_review.
calibrate_criterion must dispatch to the code-review arm only when repo_root is not None and the criterion_id is in code_review.registry.effective_criteria, preserving plan-review behavior otherwise.
EvalError from load_eval_spec in the code-review arm must be re-raised with located error context including the logical criterion_id.
Backward compatibility requires _code_review_prompt_id to admit built-in ids without repo_root and plan-review criteria to follow unchanged paths with non-None repo_root.
